title: 1. Data Integration & Source Connectivity
description: Building a Low-Latency Data Pipeline for Real-Time Intelligence.

items.title: Universal System Connectivity
items.subtitle: Seamless integration across the entire banking ecosystem.
details: **Core Banking**: Conventional, Islamic, and Agent Banking modules.
**Digital Channels**: Internet Banking, Mobile Apps, Wallets (bKash/Nagad).
**Payment Networks**: RTGS, NPSB, BEFTN, BACH, SWIFT.
**Specialized Systems**: Treasury, Trade Finance, ERP, HR, and CRM.

items.title: Real-Time Data Ingestion
items.subtitle: Low-latency capture via APIs, Kafka, and MQ.
details: **Instant Synchronization**: Sub-second data capture for analysis.
**Batch Processing**: Efficient ETL for historical data migration.
**Format Agnostic**: Native support for ISO 8583, XML, JSON, and CSV.

items.title: Unified Data Mart
items.subtitle: A single source of truth for structured and unstructured data.
details: **Schema-Less Design**: Store logs, images, and documents alongside transaction data.
**360° Customer View**: Aggregating profiles across all touchpoints.
**Forensic Readiness**: Immutable data storage for audit and legal compliance.

title: 2. Core System Capabilities
description: The Powerhouse: A Microservices-Based, AI-First Orchestration Layer.

items.title: Enterprise Scalability
items.subtitle: Cloud-native microservices architecture.
details: **Horizontal Scaling**: Efficiently handle high transaction volumes.
**High Availability**: Active-Active configuration for maximum uptime.
**Containerization**: Docker/Kubernetes ready for deployment.

items.title: Unified Risk Orchestration
items.subtitle: Centralized command center for all risk types.
details: **Holistic Monitoring**: Cross-channel fraud detection in a single pane of glass.
**Entity Resolution**: AI-driven merging of duplicate profiles.
**Dynamic Risk Scoring**: Real-time score updates based on live behavior.

items.title: Explainable AI (XAI) Core
items.subtitle: No more 'Black Box' decisions.
details: **Reason Codes**: Every AI decision comes with clear, human-readable explanations.
**Visual Evidence**: Graphical breakdown of risk factors for investigators.
**Regulatory Trust**: Fully auditable AI logic compliant with BFIU standards.

items.title: Real-Time Monitoring
items.subtitle: Identify and mitigate risk immediately.
details: **Rapid Detection**: API integration to flag high-risk transactions instantly.
**Step-Up Auth**: Trigger OTP or Biometric challenges for suspicious activities.
**Risk Mitigation**: Apply temporary monitoring or restrictions based on thresholds.

title: 3. Next-Gen AI & Cognitive Intelligence
description: Smart AI: Agentic, Adaptive, and Generative Defense.

items.title: Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Defense
items.subtitle: Autonomous agents collaborating to stop fraud.
details: **Multi-Agent Swarms**: Specialized agents (KYC, AML, Transaction) debating risk scores in real-time.
**Autonomous Triage**: Agents that automatically investigate and resolve Level-1 alerts.
**Self-Healing Models**: AI that detects performance drops and initiates retraining cycles.

items.title: Generative AI & RAG Engine
items.subtitle: Context-aware intelligence using Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
details: **Compliance Copilot**: RAG-based assistant to instantly query BFIU circulars and internal policies.
**Auto-Drafting**: Generative AI creates detailed Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for analysts.
**Knowledge Retrieval**: Semantic search to surface similar past cases and relevant evidence.

items.title: Predictive Modeling
items.subtitle: Forecast threats before they materialize.
details: **Early Warning**: Identify high-risk accounts early using behavioral patterns.
**Link Analysis**: Uncover hidden syndicates and money mule networks.
**Graph Analysis**: Visualize complex relationships between entities.

title: 4. Intelligent Rule Engine
description: Hybrid Logic: Combining Hard Rules with Soft AI Intuition.

items.title: Visual Strategy Builder
items.subtitle: No-Code, Drag-and-Drop Interface.
details: **Intuitive Design**: Create complex rules without writing a single line of code.
**BPMN Integration**: Visualize workflows and decision paths.
**Hot Deployment**: Push new rules to production instantly without downtime.

items.title: Advanced Simulation
items.subtitle: Test before you trust.
details: **What-If Analysis**: Replay historical data to predict rule impact.
**Champion/Challenger**: Run new rules in shadow mode alongside active ones.
**False Positive Optimization**: AI suggestions to tune thresholds.

items.title: Hybrid Detection
items.subtitle: The best of both worlds.
details: **Velocity Checks**: Monitor frequency (e.g., 10 txns in 1 minute).
**Complex Event Processing (CEP)**: Correlate events across time and channels.
**AI Overrides**: Allow AI to approve borderline cases based on history.

title: 5. Security & Zero-Trust Architecture
description: Enterprise-Grade Security for Your Most Critical Data.

items.title: Access Governance
items.subtitle: Strict control over who sees what.
details: **RBAC & ABAC**: Role and Attribute-based access controls.
**Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)**: Mandatory for all system admins.
**Maker-Checker**: 4-eye principle for sensitive configuration changes.

items.title: Data Security
items.subtitle: Encryption at Rest and in Motion.
details: **AES-256 Encryption**: Protecting sensitive database fields.
**TLS 1.3**: Securing all API communications.
**Data Masking**: Dynamic redaction of PII for non-privileged users.

items.title: Audit & Compliance
items.subtitle: Full traceability of every action.
details: **Immutable Logs**: Tamper-proof audit trails for forensic investigations.
**SIEM Integration**: Real-time security alerts sent to SOC.
**Vulnerability Management**: Regular scanning and patching cycles.

items.title: Backup Protocols
items.subtitle: Routine safety measures.
details: **Automated Schedules**: Daily database snapshots running in the background.
**Local & Remote Options**: Support for saving backups to external drives or cloud storage.
**File Encryption**: Basic encryption to keep backup files secure.

items.title: System Restoration
items.subtitle: Easy-to-follow recovery steps.
details: **Guided Recovery**: Clear, documented procedures for system restarts.
**Configuration Export**: Save settings to easily rebuild the environment.
**Health Monitoring**: Basic alerts if a backup job fails.

items.title: Smart Alerting
items.subtitle: Reducing alert fatigue.
details: **Risk-Based Prioritization**: Focus on high-value threats first.
**Auto-Grouping**: Combine related alerts into a single case.
**Omnichannel Notifications**: SMS, Email, and In-App alerts for analysts.

items.title: Investigative Workbench
items.subtitle: All the tools in one place.
details: **360° Case View**: Transaction history, KYC, and linked entities in one screen.
**Collaborative Tools**: Internal chat, notes, and file attachments.
**SLA Tracking**: Automated escalation for overdue cases.

items.title: Automated Reporting
items.subtitle: One-click regulatory compliance.
details: **STR/SAR Generation**: Auto-fill regulatory forms (goAML compatible).
**Evidence Packaging**: Export comprehensive case files for law enforcement.

items.title: Executive Dashboards
items.subtitle: Real-time visibility into fraud posture.
details: **Fraud Heatmaps**: Visualize attack origins and trends.
**Loss Prevention Metrics**: Track saved amounts and prevented fraud.
**Analyst Performance**: Monitor team efficiency and resolution times.

items.title: Regulatory Compliance
items.subtitle: Stay ahead of BFIU mandates.
details: **Automated STRs**: Direct integration with BFIU reporting portals.
**Audit Ready**: Pre-built reports for internal and external auditors.
**Custom Query Builder**: Drag-and-drop report creation for ad-hoc needs.

items.title: Project Execution
items.subtitle: Agile delivery methodologies.
details: **Phased Rollout**: Risk-free deployment strategy (Pilot -> Full Scale).
**Data Migration**: Secure transfer of 5 years of historical data.
**UAT Support**: Dedicated engineers for User Acceptance Testing.

items.title: Capacity Building
items.subtitle: Empowering your team.
details: **Admin Training**: Deep dive into rule tuning and system config.
**Analyst Workshops**: Best practices for fraud investigation.
**Certification**: Formal certification for Bank staff upon completion.

title: 10. Infrastructure & Future Readiness
description: Built for Today, Ready for Tomorrow.

items.title: Hardware Specs
items.subtitle: Optimized for AI workloads.
details: **GPU Acceleration**: Support for NVIDIA GPUs for faster model training.
**In-Memory Computing**: Redis/Ignite for sub-millisecond lookups.
**Storage Optimization**: Tiered storage for hot (active) and cold (archive) data.

items.title: Future Proofing
items.subtitle: Scalable for the next decade.
details: **5G Ready**: Prepared for high-velocity IoT and mobile payments.
**Blockchain Integration**: Ready to monitor crypto and CBDC transactions.
**Open API Standards**: Plug-and-play integration with future fintech partners.
